title: Terminal, Files, and Running Programs Quick Check

questions.prompt: From where is a relative path resolved?
questions.explanation: Relative paths depend on the current working directory, so establishing context prevents wrong-target errors.
The shell parses first, the operating system starts the process, streams carry data, and termination returns status.

questions.prompt: A non-zero exit status normally indicates that the command did not complete successfully.
questions.explanation: Programs use status codes so scripts and people can distinguish success from failure independently of printed text.
